title: EditorHelp: clipboard copy does not produce useful spaces or newlines
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.7.dev.custom_build [95535167b] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev (95535167b) - macOS Tahoe (26.3.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory ### Issue description When copying from an EditorHelp instance, the tables that make up the layout of the documentation yield little no plain text for space characters or newlines in many cases. For example, here are the RootMotionView properties visually in the in-editor documentation browser, with a text selection: When copying, this is what ends up on my clipboard: ``` Properties NodePathanimation_path[default: NodePath("")]floatcell_size[default: 1.0]Colorcolor[default: Color(0.5, 0.5, 1, 1)]floatradius[default: 10.0]boolzero_y[default: true] ``` I would expect something like: ``` Properties NodePath animation_path [default: NodePath("")] float cell_size [default: 1.0] Color color [default: Color(0.5, 0.5, 1, 1)] float radius [default: 10.0] bool zero_y [default: true] ``` ### Steps to reproduce - Open the in-editor documentation for any class and attempt to copy a property list, method list, etc. - Paste elsewhere to observe the plaintext representation. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
